categories.title: Vulnerability Tracker
categories.ux_direction: Security operations console: dark information-dense table, severity segmentation, asset context, and a right-side finding inspector. Make risk and remediation state immediately scannable.
categories.purpose: A triage console for tracking vulnerabilities against registered assets, with severity, affected component, owner, remediation deadline and verification status.

categories.title: Link Shortener
categories.ux_direction: Growth-oriented link management SaaS: a prominent create-link composer, compact KPI strip, active-links list, click trend and referrer breakdown. Use a light green palette and a compact top navigation.
categories.purpose: Create branded short URLs and inspect click activity, referrers and link state.

categories.title: Photo Gallery
categories.ux_direction: Editorial, image-first library. Use a charcoal canvas, minimal chrome, left album rail, masonry image grid, restrained metadata and a full-screen lightbox. The image content—not cards and tables—dominates the screen.
categories.purpose: Browse photographs by album and category, upload assets, and inspect full-resolution images in a lightbox.

categories.title: Moodboard
categories.ux_direction: Freeform studio canvas, not a dashboard. Warm paper-like background, visible object layers, draggable free-positioned objects, palette rail and sparse project controls.
categories.purpose: Arrange reference images, colours, notes and visual ideas on a spatial canvas for a design project.

categories.title: Lab Notebook
categories.ux_direction: Research notebook inspired by a paper record: notebook/experiment navigation on the left, long-form structured record in the center, unit conversion and metadata tools in a side rail. Calm scientific blue-grey palette.
categories.purpose: Record reproducible experiments with objectives, protocols, instrument metadata, measurements, observations and results.

categories.title: Maintenance Log
categories.ux_direction: Industrial maintenance control room: dark graphite/green palette, equipment register on left, work schedule in center, selected asset health and maintenance history on right.
categories.purpose: Track machines, preventive maintenance schedules, work orders, downtime and service history for a facility.

categories.title: Robot Missions
categories.ux_direction: Map-first robotics console. The central surface is a grid/facility map with robot positions, obstacles and route geometry; fleet selector on left; waypoint sequence and telemetry on right.
categories.purpose: Plan and simulate robot missions using a facility map, fleet status, ordered waypoints and telemetry.

categories.title: Sensor Dashboard
categories.ux_direction: IoT operations dashboard: teal/navy palette, clear online/offline indicators, live values with small trend plots, device inventory, historical chart and threshold editor.
categories.purpose: Monitor device telemetry, device health and thresholds from sensors sending readings to an HTTP ingestion endpoint.

categories.title: Vehicle Log
categories.ux_direction: Owner-oriented garage app. A vehicle identity/hero panel is the visual anchor, followed by running-cost metrics, dated maintenance history, cost trend and quick fuel entry.
categories.purpose: Maintain a personal vehicle record including mileage, service history, fuel, expenses and upcoming reminders.

categories.title: Flight Logbook
categories.ux_direction: Aviation logbook/EFB-inspired interface: navy and chart-table styling, pilot summary and hours, flight record table on the left, route and flight detail on the right.
categories.purpose: Record pilot flights, aircraft, routes, roles, duration and experience totals, with informational recency summaries.
